purpose: Create the standard non-Astro 6.0.0.54.92 candidate from main, carrying the accepted Pentax cancellation and pgphoto readiness fixes and packaging the optional legacy Pentax USB-SCSI transport.

changes.summary: Abort a deferred Pentax camera-timed Bulb fallback safely when the operation is cancelled before exposure begins, clearing deferred state before any shutter write.
Make pgphoto readiness fail closed unless the expected process owns the 8080 listener, while retaining the bounded slow-start window for K-1 II startup.
Include the optional legacy Pentax USB-SCSI iolib and camlib packaging path for compatible MSC bodies; this does not change the PTP path used by K-1 II and K-3 III.

validation_focus: Run the shared libgphoto2 host regression and Pentax capture-contract checks against the exact main commit.
Run the patcher deterministic suite and the full pre-release gate against the exact FwPkt artifact.
Verify the published package contains usbscsi.so and the legacy Pentax registrations while preserving K-1 II and K-3 III PTP package contents.
Before any installation, perform supervised K-1 II and K-3 III physical camera qualification and separate legacy USB-SCSI hardware qualification if available.
known_limits: This is a standard non-Astro candidate; it contains no Astro platesolve features.
The build and offline gates do not prove installation, runtime behavior, or physical camera qualification.
USB-SCSI is packaged for compatibility but has not been physically qualified on a legacy Pentax MSC body in this release.
Issue #251 cancellation behavior still requires supervised Polaris qualification on the real camera path.
